semiconductor_relevance: High — Fujikura Composites specializes in precision pneumatic control equipment and sensors that are directly applicable to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Fujikura Composites manufactures ultra-precision pneumatic control equipment, focusing on liquid control and detection sensors for semiconductor applications. Their product offerings include advanced pick & place units, air bearing cylinders, and load control units that enhance precision in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Pick & Place Unit with air bearing technology
Air Bearing Cylinder for bonding equipment
Load Control Unit for pneumatic cylinders
Liquid Detection Sensor for semiconductor processes
